title: Metal or Asphalt on a Texas House
description: Asphalt is familiar and faster to replace. Metal costs more up front and sheds heat and water differently. The house decides which one fits.
html:
Neighbors ask which roof is “best.” Best is the one that matches the house, the budget, and the weather that roof will actually see. In the Houston area that weather is heat, sudden hail, wind, and months of humidity.

Asphalt

Asphalt shingles are what most of these neighborhoods were built with. A crew can tear off and replace a typical house in one to three days. Color choices are wide. Hail bruises the mat, sun cooks off granules, and a discontinued color makes later repairs obvious. For a house you expect to be in for ten or fifteen years, a good architectural shingle is often the honest answer.

Metal

Metal roofs, especially standing seam, shed water in sheets and do not rely on granules. A light color reflects more sun than a black shingle. The panels can dent. Some policies treat dents that did not open the panel as cosmetic and will not pay for them. That detail belongs in the decision, not in the surprise after the next storm.

Noise is the myth. Metal over a solid deck, with underlayment, is not a barn roof. You hear heavy rain. You do not hear a drum solo. Fasteners matter more than the brochure: concealed clips move with heat, exposed screws depend on washers that dry out.

How we choose

We look at the deck, the pitch, the HOA, and how long you plan to keep the house. An HOA that allows only shingles ends the metal conversation until the rules change. A house under oaks, with a complicated roof full of valleys, may be happier in shingles a crew can detail tightly. A simple gable you want to stop thinking about can be a good metal roof.

Resale and the street

In a shingle neighborhood, a metal roof can look like the best house on the block or like the one that did not read the covenants. Check the HOA before you fall in love with a picture. Buyers in these suburbs understand a new architectural shingle immediately. They ask more questions about metal, and the answers are good ones if the panels, the finish, and the flashing are right. We will tell you which conversation you are about to have.
